title: Product Owner Growth (f/m/d)
description:
A consumer finance app with 1.5 million users is looking for a Product Owner for the growth squad.

What you'll do
- Own the backlog for referral, activation and retention features
- Plan and evaluate A/B tests with data analysts
- Translate customer research into user stories
- Align releases with marketing and customer support

What you bring
- 3+ years as Product Owner or Product Manager in a consumer product
- Experience with experimentation and product analytics
- Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch is a plus for working with our support team; English is the team language
- Familiar with Jira and Scrum
